subject: general
question: Which of the following characterstic is associated with desert?
solution:
The correct answer is** Barchans.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Barchans**

 
 
• The horns of the crescent on barchans, which are convex facing the wind and indicate the lateral advance of sand.
 
• A landform known as **Barchan**, often spelt **Barkhan**, is both erosional and depositional in nature.
 
• The name "**barchan**" refers to the characteristics of wide-open, inland desert areas like **Turkistan**.
 
• Where the plains have little sand cover, **Barchan dunes** are likely to occur.
 
• Both the **white sand dunes** at the **National Monument in New Mexico **and the** Grand Erg Oriental** in the **Sahara Desert** are iconic examples of barchans.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alluvial fan-**

 
 
• It is a **fan-shaped mound of alluvium** that forms as a **river's flow slows down.**
 
 
 
• **Moraine-**
 
 
• It is **material left behind by a moving glacier**. This material is usually soil and rock.
